democrats-2.title: The border is secure
lines: The claim: The border is secure. The border is closed.
The record: CBP nationwide encounters, FY2021–24: 10.83 million. A secure border does not print that number.
democrats-2.label: On the record

democrats-3.title: Antifa
lines: The claim: Antifa is an idea, not an organization.

The record: On July 4, 2025, people attacked the Prairieland Detention Center. On June 23, 2026, a court sentenced eight of them. One sentence was 100 years, for attempted murder of a police officer. The eight together were 450 years. The Justice Department called them an Antifa cell. The years are for the attack.
An idea does not throw a frozen bottle, publish an officer’s address, or fire on a detention center.
democrats-3.label: On the record

The apology did not pull the memo.

democrats-5.title: If you like your plan
lines: The claim: If you like your doctor, you can keep your doctor.
The record: PolitiFact named the companion promise, “If you like your health care plan, you can keep it,” its 2013 Lie of the Year (PolitiFact’s own record of its own award). The bill still passed.
The promise did not survive the statute.

democrats-7.title: War of choice
lines: The claim: It is a reckless war of choice.

The record: “War of choice” was said on the House floor on March 4, 2026 (Congressional Record). The post does not mention the fuel. IAEA GOV/2026/50: 440.9 kilograms of uranium enriched up to 60 percent, as of June 13, 2025. A civilian reactor uses 3 to 5 percent. Leaving that number out is the half-truth.
IAEA GOV/2026/50 Congressional Record, Mar 4, 2026
democrats-7.label: On the record

democrats-8.title: Illegal war
lines: The claim: One hundred days of Trump’s illegal war.

The record: Schumer posted that line. Khanna called the war immoral, illegal, and unstrategic. Whether Congress declared it is a separate argument under Article I. It does not erase the inspection. The 60 percent stockpile was already on the IAEA page (GOV/2026/50).
democrats-8.label: On the record

democrats-9.title: SNAP was slashed for billionaires
lines: The claim: Republicans slashed SNAP to pay for tax breaks for billionaires. Millions of children do not know where the next meal is.

The record: Public Law 119-21 changed a work rule. The Congressional Budget Office says able-bodied adults through age 64, and adults whose children are 14 or older, can draw benefits for three months in three years unless they work or train about 80 hours a month. The estimate is about 2.4 million fewer people in an average month. That is not a line that takes food from millions of children and hands it to billionaires. The work rule is the fact the post left out.
democrats-9.label: On the record

democrats-10.title: The Court found election interference
lines: The claim: The Supreme Court rebuked Trump’s election interference and blocked restrictions that would make it harder to vote.

The record: The September order is an emergency stay, docket 26A305, on a Postal Service rule, issued before the midterms. It is not a judgment that the President committed election interference. On June 29, 2026, in Watson v. Republican National Committee, the Court read the election-day statutes, 2 U.S.C. §§ 1 and 7 and 3 U.S.C. § 1. Those statutes do not say when a mailed ballot must arrive. A reading of a statute is not a finding that the law was broken.
democrats-10.label: On the record

democrats-11.title: Stop the second segment
lines: The claim: The hallway clip was a lie. He was a political prisoner. Order the host to stop, and keep the rest of the tape in the House.

The record: The hallway minute is real. The plea came in September 2021, before the broadcast. Judge Lamberth later called the aired videos decidedly not exculpatory. The U.S. Attorney’s tally at forty-eight months: about 1,583 charged, about 1,009 guilty pleas, about 667 sentenced to incarceration, about 608 charged with assaulting officers, zero charged under 18 U.S.C. § 2383. Those pleas were taken while the public did not have the archive. Speaker Johnson said about 5 percent of the hours would stay back for security. The uncensored hours were offered in a viewing room inside the Capitol. The country could not travel there. The website stayed a fraction. On March 7, 2023, Majority Leader Schumer told Rupert Murdoch, from the Senate floor, to stop a second segment. A pardon on January 20, 2025, is not a finding that the pleas were forced. The Speaker’s files: the House Administration Subcommittee channel on Rumble. www.stophate.com is a private site, not that archive.
democrats-11.label: On the record
